## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C-style IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-07-16: S-1/A Amendment No. 1 attaches Exhibit 10.18, the form-of SkinnyPop Tax Receivable Agreement (85% sharing on pre-IPO basis step-ups from the July 2014 SkinnyPop acquisition).
- 2015-08-04: TRA executed at IPO pricing between Amplify, the former Topco unitholders, and TA Associates Management, L.P. as stockholders representative.

#### Hershey acquisition and TRA extinguishment

- 2017-12-17: 8-K announces the Hershey merger agreement (cash tender offer); deal value includes a $76 million make-whole payment to the TRA counterparty.
- 2018-01-31: Tender offer closes; Amplify becomes a wholly-owned Hershey subsidiary, and the $76 million make-whole payment from Hershey extinguishes the TRA.

## Explanation

Amplify executed the SkinnyPop Tax Receivable Agreement on August 4, 2015 at its Up-C-style IPO, committing to pay 85% of the U.S. federal, state, and local tax benefits realized from pre-IPO basis step-ups generated by the July 2014 SkinnyPop acquisition; the initial undiscounted obligation was estimated at approximately $96.1 million. In December 2015 the former Topco unitholders collectively assigned their beneficiary interests to TA Associates Management, L.P. under the contract's existing Article V transfer provisions, with no amendment to the contract itself. The Hershey merger agreement signed December 17, 2017 preserved the TRA during the interim period and did not specify a contractual termination, but Hershey's December 18, 2017 press release and Parallaxes Capital commentary identify a $76 million make-whole payment to the TRA counterparty as a component of deal value, which extinguished the TRA at the tender-offer close on January 31, 2018. Verification against Hershey's 2018 10-K tax footnote (CIK 0000047111) was not completed, so the make-whole figure is sourced from the deal-announcement disclosure rather than the post-close acquirer accounting. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
